item.title: Tinubu strips NNPC of power to deduct revenue, orders direct remittance to FAAC
item.description: PRESIDENT Bola Tinubu has signed an executive order on direct remittance of oil and gas revenues to the Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC).
